entries.bf1025f17b745bad: In oil transport, its strengths are the ability to use two transport methods with different characteristics: rail tank car transport, which moves large volumes over long distances, and road transport, which is highly mobile and responds flexibly to a variety of transport needs. In high-pressure gas transport, its strengths are its experience and track record in LNG transport, continued since 1984, and safe and stable transport through safety education and training for crew members using a dedicated training facility. In chemical product transport, its strengths are its range of container types and transport that makes use of the mobility of automobile companies within the group.
